spec.description:
Polyester Solutions
PolyBatts are high-performance, non-irritant thermal and acoustic insulation
batts manufactured in Melbourne, Australia from 100% thermally bonded polyester
fibers containing a minimum of 80% recycled PET. Completely free from chemical
binders, resins, and formaldehyde, they are non-toxic, odorless, non-allergenic,
and safe to handle without protective clothing or dust masks. Engineered to fit
snugly into wall and ceiling framing cavities, they will not sag, rot, or become
brittle over their lifecycle, providing lasting thermal resistance from R1.5 to
R4.0.
features:
100% Australian made from thermally bonded polyester
fibers
Contains a minimum of 80% recycled post-consumer PET plastic bottles

Completely non-irritant, non-toxic, odorless, and non-allergenic with zero
itch

installation
Does not absorb moisture; hydrophobic and quick-drying
Resistant to insect, vermin, mold, and bacterial attack

Will not sag,
crumble, settle, or become brittle over time

Meets Australian Standard
AS/NZS 4859.1 and Building Code of Australia (BCA)

Tested to AS 1530.3 with
zero spread of flame and zero heat evolved

100% recyclable with zero chemical
binders or adhesives

install:
Turn
off power at the main switchboard before entering ceiling spaces or touching
wall framing

Select batt width (430mm or 580mm) matching stud or joist
spacing (450mm or 600mm)

In ceilings, lay batts flat between joists ensuring
continuous coverage with no gaps or compression

In walls, friction-fit batts
firmly between studs ensuring batts butt tightly against top and bottom plates

Maintain minimum 50mm clearance around non-IC rated recessed downlights and
flues per AS 3999

Maintain 20mm clearance between roof cladding/sarking and
insulation at roof eaves

Tear across width by hand or trim with heavy-duty
shears if custom sizing is required
selection_checklist:
Confirm
application (ceiling vs external wall vs internal partition)

Select required
R-value to achieve target NatHERS energy rating for climate zone

Measure
framing centers (430mm for 450mm centers; 580mm for 600mm centers)

Confirm preference for non-itchy,
non-allergenic polyester insulation
limitations:
Do not compress batts significantly as this reduces thermal
R-value

Must be enclosed behind plasterboard or building lining; not for
exposed decorative finish
spec.warranty: Backed by Polyester Solutions manufacturer product warranty

retrieval.rag_summary:
Polyester
Solutions PolyBatts are Australian-made thermal and acoustic insulation batts
manufactured from 100% thermally bonded polyester fibers containing at least 80%
recycled PET plastic bottles. Completely free of formaldehyde, chemical binders,
and respirable glass fibers, they are non-toxic, non-allergenic, and safe to
handle without protective gear. Available in wall ratings from R1.5 to R2.5 and
ceiling ratings from R2.0 to R4.0, they maintain permanent thickness without
sagging or slumping, backed by AS/NZS 4859.1 compliance and a lifetime product
warranty.
